channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Brodie Ziemer, Will Zellers lead Team USA to World Junior Championship victory over Switzerland
item.description: The United States captain and Gophers forward sparked his team to its second victory in as many games at Grand Casino Arena.

item.title: Downsizing during the holidays? What to do when your kids don’t want your stuff
item.description: As more Minnesota baby boomers age, they’re increasingly confronting the downsizing dilemma as younger generations refuse to take family heirlooms.

item.title: Souhan: Vikings need to bring safety Harrison Smith back
item.description: The potential future Hall of Famer is playing like a star again, which means the team should look at signing him up for a 15th NFL season.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild turn defeat into overtime victory at Winnipeg to kick off road trip
item.description: Mats Zuccarello forced OT with 22 seconds left in regulation with a 6-on-4 goal, and Matt Boldy ended it 39 seconds into OT.

item.title: As demand rises, halal food options shrink at Minnesota food shelves
item.description: Isuroon was forced to close one of its four locations and the Brian Coyle Center’s food shelf often runs short before it can serve all families in need, a sign of the strain many families are facing.

item.title: Serial entrepreneur and 2nd Wind founder Dick Enrico dies at 85
item.description: The Minnesota businessman left his mark on generations with the slogan: “Why buy new when slightly used will do?”

item.title: A Minneapolis neighborhood cradles this grieving Annunciation family
item.description: Amid never-ending grief after their 8-year-old son’s murder, Fletcher Merkel’s family finds strength in community.

item.title: Winter storm to bring snow, possible blizzard conditions to Minnesota on Sunday
item.description: A winter storm warning has been issued for much of eastern Minnesota, while a blizzard warning is in effect for portions of central and southern Minnesota.
